summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state initialised in the constructor and set/cleared in the run entry point's try/finally. Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py with 10 tests covering not-running (before and after run), same-thread error, return value, awaitable callable, widget access, timeout exception propagation, variadic positional forwarding, keyword forwarding, and exit value. All 10 pass with PYTHONPATH=src and the process exits cleanly. Caveats: the venv's textual points at base/, so I used PYTHONPATH=src to test this repo; the wider suite has 68 failures from async tests lacking pytest-asyncio in this environment, which I did not verify against the unmodified tree; tests/cli, tests/devtools and snapshot_tests were excluded. Nothing committed.
